title: Master fails cargo fmt --check in 18 test files, and the full gate has no formatting stage
outcome: Master fails cargo fmt --check in 18 test files, and the full gate has no formatting stage
acceptance: `cargo fmt -- --check` exits 0 on master, by a formatting-only commit that changes no behaviour (no test or product logic edits).

The maintained full gate (scripts/test-launcher.mjs full), or another recorded standing check, runs `cargo fmt -- --check`, so new formatting drift fails the gate; or, if that is decided against, the decision and its reason are recorded on this item by the coordinator.
